entry.intro: Give a clue to a hidden spot between two opposites, and see how close your friends can turn the dial. You get a code to share.

leaveConfirm: You will not be able to come back.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends.
lobby.unlockColours: Unlock any colour in the shop. Set your usual one under Profile.
lobby.soloText: Each guesser turns their own dial. The closest guess scores the most.
lobby.teamText: The guessers share one marker, move it together and anyone locks it in. Everyone scores the same.
lobby.totalTurns: {turns} turns in all with {players} players. Everyone takes turns as the psychic.

table.teamMarkerNote: One marker for the whole team.
table.bandsLegend: The target has three bands: 4, 3 and 2 points.
table.onlyYouSeeTarget: Only you can see the target.

status.wins: {names} wins with {score} points. | {names} win with {score} points.
status.teamTurn: Your team scores {points} for this turn.
status.youArePsychic: You are the psychic: the target is shown on your dial. Type a clue that points to it, without numbers or the words on the dial.
status.psychicTeam: Your clue is in. Your team is moving the marker together. You cannot see it until the reveal.
status.teamMove: Move the marker together until you all agree, then anyone can lock it in.
status.psychicWaiting: Your clue is in. Waiting for everyone to guess ({n} of {total}).
status.guessLocked: Guess locked in. Waiting for the others ({n} of {total}).
status.guessNow: Your turn: read the clue and turn the dial to where you think the target is.
status.abandonedNote: Too many players left, so this game does not count towards the statistics.
status.leaveHint: Use Leave game (top right) to go back to the menu.
status.finishedHint: Use Leave game (top right) to go back to the menu, or "All rounds" in the score bar to see every turn again.
status.everyGuess: Every guess is on the dial.
status.waitingNext: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the next turn.
status.waitingFinal: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the final scores.
status.closeScores: Close the scores when you are ready to carry on.
status.waitTeamLock: Wait for your team to lock in.
status.teamDrag: Drag on the dial, or use the slider. Everyone sees the marker move.
status.dragHint: Drag on the dial, or use the slider under it.
status.lockHint: Lock it in when you are ready.

reveal.label: This turn
reveal.teamLocked: {name} locked it in for the team: +{points} for everyone.

log.turnStart: Turn {n} of {total}: {name} is the psychic, between {left} and {right}.
log.teamLock: {name} locked in the marker for the team (+{points} for everyone).
log.reveal: The target is revealed. {name} scores {points} for the clue.
log.gameOver: The game is over: {names} wins. | The game is over: {names} win.

errors.notAMode: That is not a way to play.
errors.clueGiven: The clue has already been given.
errors.psychicOnlyClue: Only the psychic gives the clue.
errors.teamOneMarker: Your team has one marker: move it together, then lock it in.
errors.psychicCannotGuess: You are the psychic, so you cannot guess.
errors.dialRange: Turn the dial to a place between the two ends.
errors.notATeamGame: This game is not played in a team.
errors.psychicTeamMarker: You are the psychic: your team moves the marker.
errors.markerRange: Move the marker to a place between the two ends.
